sources.fait: "Grand Theft Auto VI is a single player experience, coming November 19 to PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S" (Rockstar Newswire, pre-order announcement)

Take-Two shareholder meeting (17/09/2026), as reported: "GTA 6 is a single-player title [...] We will continue to support GTA Online after GTA VI release and beyond."

scenes.texte: GTA 6 is finally out. But you can't play it online.
scenes.label: Single-player only

scenes.texte: That's Rockstar's own wording: GTA 6 is a single player experience. The PlayStation FAQ says the same.

carte.texte: "Grand Theft Auto VI is a single player experience."

scenes.texte: So at launch, there is no online mode and no co-op. You play Jason and Lucia's story on your own.
And GTA Online is not shutting down. Take-Two told shareholders it will keep supporting it after GTA 6.
scenes.label: GTA Online continues

scenes.texte: In 2013, GTA Online arrived about two weeks after GTA 5. For GTA 6, Rockstar has announced no online date yet.
scenes.label: No online date announced

scenes.texte: Online or story mode: which one matters more to you? Tell me in the comments, and follow for verified GTA 6 news.
scenes.label: Online or story?
